Sparse frames cannot establish every event, object identity or source provenance.

Test one category-prompt change on development only: define label boundaries and classify central topic/purpose using transcript and visible text, with the existing generated summary as supporting evidence. Reserve broad Entertainment for cases without a better supported specific label. Treat this as an untested hypothesis.
